notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR33: data-name-5 "is set only by the MCS as part of the execution of a RECEIVE statement": 3 end of group, 2 end of message, 0 less than a message (MESSAGE); 3, 2, 1 end of segment, 0 (SEGMENT); the first rule satisfied wins. PendingReceive#Next returns 0 for a partial transfer, 3 or 2 at the last segment by the message's EGI flag, and 1 only under the SEGMENT phrase; MessageControlSession#Transfer writes it at position 31 through CommunicationArea#SetReceived. Probes at --std 85: MESSAGE of a two-segment message 2, partial 0 then the group's end 3; SEGMENT 0, 1, then the group's last segment 3 (rule c), the last segment of a plain message 2; NO DATA leaves a moved 9; the witness accepts 0/2/3.

next.reason: 1985: "The content of the data item referenced by data-name-5 is set only by the MCS as part of the execution of a RECEIVE statement"; 2023: "No communication description entry or end key; 2023 RECEIVE (14.9.31) is message-server based with no data-name-5 setting". 2023 has no CD entry, so no end-key item set to 0-3. Its RECEIVE candidates use a message-server model and say nothing of end-of-group, message or segment indicators.
